description: The plot illustrates the impact of hyperparameter N on AUC, showing the relationship between N and AUC for different datasets. The x-axis is labeled "N", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 20 with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "AUC (%)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 75 to 100 with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are five lines in the plot, each representing a different dataset: SMD (orange, square marker, solid line), PSM (green, circle marker, solid line), SWaT (purple, star marker, solid line), SMAP (red, triangle marker, solid line), and MSL (blue, diamond marker, solid line). The lines generally increase as N increases from 0 to 20, with SMD starting at around 80% and ending at around 95%, PSM starting at around 85% and ending at around 95%, SWaT starting at around 85% and ending at around 95%, SMAP starting at around 80% and ending at around 90%, and MSL starting at around 80% and ending at around 90%. The lines exhibit varying trends, with some showing a steady increase and others displaying a more rapid increase between N = 5 and N = 10.
